rationale: GPU audio compute input validation only: GpuCompute and the shared-I/O WaveNet spec now bound each layer's causal reach (2^20 samples) and size history rings in 64-bit arithmetic with a device binding-size check, so untrusted model files cannot stall or exhaust preparation. No kernel output changes; no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves; no UI paint path changes.
